title: The calendar clauses of a shared vacation home agreement
description: Write the calendar part of your shared vacation home plan: turns, holidays, unused nights, changes, and who keeps the current schedule.
summary: Write down who shares the calendar, how dates are allocated, how holidays work, when unused nights become available, and how changes are confirmed. Name the current calendar and the person who keeps it up to date. This is an everyday house plan, not an ownership agreement or legal document.
